sbml2map — e_coli_core

EX reactions with no connection to main pathways: 0. These stay gray. No connections are added.

Orange: undirected paths connecting main pathways to exchange (EX) reactions. Local relocation reduces overlapping orange lines from different reactions, then compares total length; shared branches within one reaction count once. Point crossings are allowed. Gray: other branches. Only EX reactions use the outer grid boundary. Filters may hide parts of these paths.

Inorganic compounds are hidden. Red: main pathways (glucose exchange, glycolysis, pyruvate oxidation, TCA). No flux sampling. Red pathways come first, followed by orange connectors, then other reactions. Each group is sorted by reaction ID, not activity. Squares: reactions. Circles: compounds. Small gray circles: cofactors. Arrows show directions allowed by model bounds. Reversible reactions have arrows both ways. Reactions with both bounds at zero have no arrows.

The slider filters the saved layout. To calculate a new layout, run the CLI with --coverage.

PNGSVGEscherValidationRanking

TCA shape: square. Interior node placement is allowed; the TCA perimeter remains fixed. 12 matched EX / extracellular / cytosolic triplets are collinear, ordered from outside inward.

Purple: user selection

Selection changes this HTML view. PNG files are updated by running the CLI.
